scope: Lean constructs the positive shifted resolvents of the actual homogeneous Hamiltonian, proves both inverse equations, positivity, self-adjointness, the 1/a norm bound, and strong convergence of normalized resolvents to identity. Its positive bounded Yosida operators are norm-continuous in time and converge strongly on the fixed-time Hamiltonian domain. The form-space inverse is continuously differentiable. These finite matrices check transcription only. Convergence of evolving states, an unbounded time-dependent unitary propagator, the full six-mode limit, regulator removal, physical identification and TOE remain open.
